events.label: birth
events.text: Born in Aitkin, Minnesota.

evidence.quote: McKay was born on March 17 , 1910 in Aitkin , Minnesota

events.text: Moved with parents to Oregon, settling in Bend.

evidence.quote: In 1911 , when he was less than a year old , McKay moved with his parents to Oregon

events.text: Graduated from high school in Bend.

evidence.quote: graduating from high school there in 1929

events.text: Left Bend to work for Oregon Highway Department.

evidence.quote: In 1930 , McKay left Bend to take a job with the Oregon Highway Department

events.text: Began first assignment with Bureau of Reclamation at Parker Dam.

evidence.quote: His first assignment with the bureau began in 1934 at Parker Dam

events.text: Married Melba T. McKay.

evidence.quote: In 1936 , McKay married Melba T . McKay

events.text: Transferred to Marshall Ford Dam near Austin, Texas.

evidence.quote: McKay worked at Parker Dam for a total of four years before transferring to Marshall Ford Dam near Austin , Texas

events.text: Reassigned to a power station in Phoenix, Arizona.

evidence.quote: He remained there until 1942 , when he was reassigned to a power station in Phoenix , Arizona

events.text: Left Bureau of Reclamation to join the US Navy.

evidence.quote: In early 1943 , McKay left the Bureau of Reclamation to join the United States Navy

events.text: Discharged from the US Navy.

evidence.quote: McKay was discharged from the navy in early 1946

events.text: Moved to Los Angeles and sold real estate there.

evidence.quote: After leaving the navy , McKay moved to Los Angeles , where he sold real estate for four years

events.text: Returned to Bend, Oregon.

evidence.quote: He returned to Bend in 1950 , becoming vice president of Deschutes County Title and Abstract Company

events.text: Became vice president of Deschutes County Title and Abstract Company.

evidence.quote: He returned to Bend in 1950 , becoming vice president of Deschutes County Title and Abstract Company

events.text: Wife Melba died of cancer.

evidence.quote: In 1952 , McKays wife Melba died of cancer at the age of 40

events.text: Married Evelyn Ruth Watson.

evidence.quote: A year later , McKay married Evelyn Ruth Watson

events.text: Began service on Bend-La Pine School Board.

evidence.quote: He served on the Bend-La Pine School Board for eleven years , from 1953 through 1963

events.text: Elected president of Oregon Land Title Association.

evidence.quote: He was elected president of that organization in 1957

events.label: award
events.text: Named Bend community's Boss of the Year.

evidence.quote: In 1959 , he was chosen as the Bend communitys Boss of the Year

events.label: award
events.text: Honored as Bend's Senior Citizen of the Year.

evidence.quote: A year later , he was honored as Bends Senior Citizen of the Year

events.text: Ended service on Bend-La Pine School Board.

evidence.quote: He served on the Bend-La Pine School Board for eleven years , from 1953 through 1963

events.text: Won general election for Oregon State Senate, District 19, over Charles L. Allen.

evidence.quote: In the general election that followed , McKay defeated the Democratic candidate , Charles L . Allen of Tumalo

events.text: Appointed to Ways and Means committee during 1965 session.

evidence.quote: The 1965 legislative session lasted just over four months , from January 11 through May 14

events.text: Began first Oregon State Senate term (District 19).

evidence.quote: The 1965 legislative session lasted just over four months , from January 11 through May 14

events.text: Chaired elections committee; vice-chaired commerce and utilities committee.

evidence.quote: The 1967 session began on January 11 and lasted through June 14

events.text: Won unopposed general election for second Senate term (District 19).

evidence.quote: In 1968 , McKay ran for a second term representing District 19

events.text: Began second Oregon State Senate term.

evidence.quote: The 1969 legislative session lasted just over three months , starting on January 13 and ending on April 23

events.text: Chaired rules and resolutions committee.

evidence.quote: The 1969 legislative session lasted just over three months , starting on January 13 and ending on April 23

events.label: legislation
events.text: Helped enact legislation revising the state criminal code.

evidence.quote: During the session , he helped enact legislation that revised the states criminal code

events.text: Chaired financial affairs committee; vice-chaired rules and resolutions committee.

evidence.quote: McKay attended the regular 1971 legislative session

events.text: Lost general election for District 27 to Fred W. Heard.

evidence.quote: In 1972 , McKay ran for a third senate term

events.text: Left Oregon State Senate when second term expired.

evidence.quote: McKay left the state senate in January 1973 when his second term expired

events.label: death
events.text: Died of a heart attack at his home in Bend.

evidence.quote: McKay died of a heart attack at his home in Bend on October 26 , 1990
